literal: From within (my) eye, (he) does not depart; if (I) blink, will (he) suffer pain? Subtle is my lover.
translation: My lover does not depart from within my eyes; if I blink, will he suffer pain? So subtle is his form.
modern: என் காதலர் என் கண்ணின் உள்ளிருந்து வெளியே போக மாட்டார்; நான் கண்ணிமைத்தால் அவர் துன்புறுவாரோ? என் காதலர் அவ்வளவு நுட்பமானவர்.
explanation: The heroine expresses her deep love by imagining her lover residing permanently inside her eyes. She says he never leaves this inner sanctuary. Because he is so delicate and subtle in form, she worries that the simple act of blinking her eyes might squeeze or hurt him. This poetic imagery beautifully illustrates how constantly and intimately her lover occupies her vision and thoughts.
